visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera moves forward through the automatic sliding glass doors of a brightly lit 7-Eleven convenience store. The interior features white tiled floors, rows of refrigerated drinks, and display shelves stocked with green and yellow boxes. A man in a dark puffer jacket is seated at a wooden counter-style table with high stools. (2) The shot changes to a close-up of a brown cardboard box sitting on the wooden table next to a red gift bag. A hand enters the frame and begins opening the box's top flaps, revealing blue plastic-wrapped merchandise with Japanese text and a yellow McDonald's logo underneath. (3) The camera pans up to show the man at the table. He has short black hair, wears glasses, and is dressed in a grey sweater under his dark puffer jacket. He smiles broadly at the camera while holding up a peace sign with his right hand. The background is filled with stacks of red and gold Chinese New Year gift boxes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A distinctive electronic chime signals the entry into a store, followed by a soft bed of upbeat, synth-driven pop music. A male voice begins speaking with high energy and positive inflection. (2) Rapid crinkling sounds of cardboard and plastic wrap indicate the unboxing process. The speaker's volume increases as he expresses excitement. A female voice is heard laughing and providing brief affirmative comments in the background. (3) The male speaker reaches a peak in vocal arousal, shouting exclamations of joy. The background music continues at a steady, moderate tempo with a bright, clean frequency profile, ending with natural store ambience.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share the excitement of receiving and unboxing a special New Year's gift, specifically a McDonald's x Evangelion collaboration item, while thanking a specific individual or entity referred to as the 'EV Expert'.
